🔥 हॉलीवुड के सुपरस्टार जॉनी डेप ने कर ली है धमाकेदार वापसी! 🎬

लगभग एक दशक के लंबे ब्रेक के बाद जॉनी डेप ने हॉलीवुड में वापसी कर ली है।
उनकी यह वापसी Charles Dickens की कहानी पर बनी फिल्म Ebenezer से हो रही है।
लेकिन हैरानी की बात यह है कि इस फिल्म के लिए उन्हें अपने करियर की सबसे बड़ी कमाई से 94 प्रतिशत कम फीस मिली है।
Variety रिपोर्ट के मुताबिक, Ebenezer में Scrooge का रोल निभाने के लिए जॉनी डेप को 5 मिलियन डॉलर upfront मिल रहे हैं।
उनकी सबसे ज्यादा कमाई वाली फिल्म Pirates of the Caribbean: Dead Men Tell No Tales थी, जिससे उन्होंने backend profits मिलाकर 90 मिलियन डॉलर कमाए थे।
यानी इस बार उन्हें लगभग 85 मिलियन डॉलर कम मिल रहे हैं, हालांकि Ebenezer के backend profits की जानकारी अभी सामने नहीं आई है।
Amber Heard के साथ defamation trial के बाद यह उनकी पहली बड़ी हॉलीवुड स्टूडियो रिलीज है।
इस लिमिटेड 38 मिलियन डॉलर बजट वाली फिल्म में Rupert Grint, Ian McKellen और Daisy Ridley जैसे कलाकार भी हैं।
क्या आपको लगता है कि कम फीस के साथ वापसी करना जॉनी डेप का एक स्मार्ट मूव है? 💸🤔

ctx.text:
There was a time when Johnny Depp could walk into a Hollywood movie and claim a million-dollar paycheck. In fact, his biggest payday came from the Pirates of the Caribbean movie Dead Men Tell No Tales, which earned him a whopping $90 million , including backend profits. But after a decade, that story has changed completely. As you already know, Johnny Depp has made his comeback to Hollywood after almost a decade with the adaptation of Charles Dickens’ A Christmas Carol. After some personal life challenges with his wife, Amber Heard, his return to work came with a whopping 94% pay cut. Yes, compared to his last record-breaking earnings from the Pirates of the Caribbean franchise, Depp had to settle for a 94% decrease. So, how much is Hollywood actually paying him?
According to Variety , Johnny Depp is reportedly earning $5 million up front for playing Scrooge in Ebenezer. Yes, that’s a drop of almost $85 million. However, in Dead Men Tell No Tales, Depp’s $90 million paycheck included backend profits too. That means he received a share of the movie’s financial success in addition to his upfront payment. And his Ebenezer paycheck of $5 million is only his upfront payment, and what he is receiving in backend is still unknown. Still, we can’t unsee the major difference. Even for a cameo role in Alice in Wonderland back in 2010, Depp reportedly received a paycheck between $50 million and $75 million , according to The Telegraph . Even his reported payment for Fantastic Beasts was triple his present paycheck. However, Johnny Depp had his reasons for charging so much for the Pirates of the Caribbean franchise. In a Vanity Fair interview back in 2011, the actor accepted that his Pirates paychecks were ridiculous and that he accepted them because of his children. However, with a huge salary came huge criticism too. Even back in 2015, Forbes listed him as the most overpaid actor.
I think Depp’s smaller paycheck was only a kick-start and a very smart move, especially considering the popularity Ebenezar is giving him.
After the highly publicized defamation trial against his wife, Amber Heard , this is Depp’s first major Hollywood studio release. So, this movie gives him a chance to revisit his legacy and enjoy a mainstream theatrical release. With a popular cast of Rupert Grint, Ian McKellen , Daisy Ridley, and more, the movie’s production budget is also quite limited, reportedly $38 million. Besides, if the movie does well, it will again push him towards the 8-figure mark, or maybe 9.
